proof_text:
have h₁ : multiply (a) (b) h_precond = a * b := by
    rw [multiply]
    <;> simp [multiply_precond, multiply_postcond]
    <;> aesop

  have h₂ : multiply_postcond (a) (b) (multiply (a) (b) h_precond) h_precond := by
    have h₃ : multiply (a) (b) h_precond = a * b := h₁
    have h₄ : multiply_postcond (a) (b) (multiply (a) (b) h_precond) h_precond := by
      rw [h₃]
      constructor <;> simp [multiply_postcond, multiply_precond]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> simp_all
      <;> linarith
    exact h₄

  exact h₂
